_help: Feeds the collector tries every morning. type = ical | wp-tribe | jsonld | ticketmaster | studentlivet. A feed that fails is just skipped and shows as ok:false in events.json → sources. Set enabled:false to turn one off. source must be one of: liu, lintek, msek, frryd, hg, karhus, intl, city, other.

window.note: Only events overlapping this range go into events.json (her stay in Linköping). Remove to collect everything.
